newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates ends softer, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates ends softer, seen stable.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Monday and dealers expected the rates to stay around current levels despite loose liquidity in the banking system.

Tuesday's auction of T$50 billion government bonds would mop up excess liquidity, dealers said. The overnight interbank rate closed at 5.053 percent against Saturday's 5.083, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 5.10-5.15.
The bond market saw no transaction in the afternoon. In the morning, the seven-year 86/3 bond yield was at 6.0050 and the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.1775.
